_note: EXPLORATORY (post-review, after the test passes): raw failure-score routing for reranking, i.e. rerank the top b of test queries by the learned failure gate's score with no calibration, minus random routing (b * mean Delta), averaged over b in {10, 25, 50, 75}%.
